title: Mechanical Technician
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Mechanical Supervisor

Background

  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

  • A Mechanical Technician is authorized to maintain and repair vessel mechanical equipment and systems.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives, Instrumentation probationer techs.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Dismantle, repair and reassemble mechanical equipment; identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling; use correct procedures and method of dismantling; carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure; identify, check and prepare components; apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Use of condition monitoring on mechanical equipment; adjust instruments to meet operating specifications; minimize disruption and waste; monitor and record work history.
  • 3) Diagnose faults in mechanical equipment; respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures; select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures; carry out visual, close and detailed inspections; use inspection results to determine actions; record a full description in the history.
  • 4) Monitor and maintain pollution control measures; identify and halt unplanned discharges where possible and report according to policy, procedure and regulation; use relevant PPE; dispose of equipment and materials per procedure; enforce environmental protection with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Contribute to health and safety of the working environment; keep work areas clean and free of hazards; take positive action to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors; raise alarms and report incidents to the supervisor.
  • 6) Emergency response; carry out emergency response role (see Station Bill) and demonstrate competence in drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only - Generic Functional Competencies

  • Offshore - Demonstrate an understanding of P&IDs
  • Offshore - Routine servicing of systems and equipment
  • Offshore - Rectifying faults in systems and equipment
  • Offshore - Handover
  • Offshore - Emergency response
  • Offshore - Diagnosis and fault finding
  • Offshore - Planning work
  • Offshore - Dismantling, repair and reassemble equipment
  • Offshore - Safety management

Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience

  • FOR GENERAL MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
  • FOR PSV CALIBRATION MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Proven experience and/or qualified in PRV/PSV calibration or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with PSV calibration (offshore preferred).
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
  • FOR CRANE AND HYDRAULIC MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Extensive experience in Hydraulic Cranes Maintenance. Offshore environment would be preferable.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of Crane and Lifting International Standards
  • Good knowledge of CMMS systems such as AMOS / IFS and ePTW

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro‑services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and Charmhub.io marketplaces; behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution – architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world‑class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Location

This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.

  • Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices
  • Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high‑quality software
  • You value and nurture great team culture and spirit
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum

  • Recognition rewards

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:

Job Overview

We are seeking a corrosion engineer to join the Southern Area Asset Integrity Division (SAAID) of SAOP Technical Support Department.

SAAID is responsible for providing effective and proactive corrosion management support to safeguard assets while adopting best industry practices and cutting-edge technologies.

Your primary role is to perform integrity and corrosion analysis studies to assess current challenges and develop a mitigation plan by implementing cost effective solutions and deployment of advanced and proven technologies to prevent or significantly reduce the impact of corrosion. This is to be supported with benchmarking and implementation of strategies that will enhance the long‑term reliability and asset efficiency of our assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform periodical analytical study of corrosion assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs
  • Research and Deploy emerging Technologies related to corrosion mitigation and non‑metallic deployment.
  • Act as expert corrosion and asset integrity management resource for corrosion risk assessment and mitigation.
  • Develop Pipeline Integrity Plans (PIP) aligned with the organization integrity performance objectives, assigning responsibilities, and timeframes for the responsible stakeholder.
  • Develop annual condition assessment schedule in line with the PIP recommendations.
  • Review PIP trends and initiate detailed engineering studies accordingly (e.g. increase in internal corrosion features, encroachment to pipelines, low quality of ILI reports, failure investigations, etc.)
  • Facilitate the investigation of corrosion failure and deploy lesson learned from the root cause analysis to the system to avoid reoccurrence.
  • Perform periodical analytical study of assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs.
  • Evaluate the QA findings and perform periodical analytical study of assessment findings to overcome challenging inspection programs.
  • Provide consultation on specialized area related to corrosion control.
  • Perform integrity and corrosion analysis studies to assess current challenges.
  • Monitor the corrosion parameters such PH, O2, bacteria, residual of biocide chemical, and take corrective actions accordingly.
  • Review the inspection data and make corrosion control recommendations/reports accordingly.
  • Review laboratory data/parameters and issue the recommendations accordingly.
  • Apply corrosion monitoring system/program to ensure the integrity & reliability of the plant assets.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in corrosion Engineering from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have 15 years‑experience in corrosion engineering, including at least three years as senior corrosion engineer.
  • Must have a comprehensive knowledge of corrosion principles, including electrochemistry, material properties, corrosion mechanisms, and corrosion prevention methods.
  • Should also have sufficient background in various laboratory and field‑testing techniques used to assess corrosion behavior, such as accelerated corrosion testing, electrochemical corrosion monitoring, and non‑destructive testing methods.
  • Familiarity with corrosion prevention and control strategies, including material selection, protective coatings, cathodic protection, corrosion inhibitors, and corrosion monitoring systems is a requirement.
  • Understanding of industry standards and codes related to corrosion, such as National Association of Corrosion Engineers (NACE), American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) International standards, and API (American Petroleum Institute) standards.
  • Practical experience through entry‑level positions or corrosion engineering roles in industries such as oil and gas, aerospace, chemical processing, marine, or infrastructure.
  • Demonstrate effective analytical and communication skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, prepare technical reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Awareness about the latest advancements in corrosion science and technologies through professional development courses, certifications, workshops, conferences, and memberships in relevant industry organizations.

Overview

Cyrex, a Magic Media company, is a media and tech start-up powered by creativity and innovation. If you\'re an enthusiastic, motivated, and lateral thinker, our team is waiting to meet you!

This is a full-time position. The role requires strong low-level technical skills, such as C++ programming, working with network protocols, or reverse engineering. If your experience is mainly in web hacking, you should instead apply for the on-demand penetration testing position, which focuses more on web security.

Responsibilities

  • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games
  • Reverse engineer game binaries and network protocols to identify vulnerabilities
  • Bypass client-side protections (SSL pinning, anti-cheat, packing/obfuscation)
  • Develop and maintain internal tools and PoCs (C++, Python)

Requirements

  • 5+ years in penetration testing, reverse engineering or security research
  • Strong modern C++ and Python experience

  • Minimal RE capability: read disassembly when needed; use IDA/Ghidra and x64dbg/WinDbg/LLDB to support testing (deep reversing not required)
  • Basic web hacking knowledge

Working knowledge

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp

Benefits

  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects
  • The chance to work closely with a team of like-minded creative professionals in a fast-paced, multicultural environment on a variety of gaming projects
  • A competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities

If this sounds interesting to you and you\'d like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we\'d love to hear from you.

title: Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Descrição da vaga

Trabalhar na Norsul é fazer parte da maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — e contribuir, todos os dias, com o que mantém essa estrutura viva, confiável e em movimento.

Mesmo fora do mar, você está a bordo: garantindo que processos funcionem, decisões aconteçam e a operação siga com consistência, segurança e cuidado.

Aqui, o impacto não está só nos navios — está também em cada planilha, em cada conversa, em cada escolha feita com atenção e responsabilidade.

O que você entrega faz diferença. E o jeito como você entrega também.

Porque na Norsul, pertender é saber que sua atuação ajuda a sustentar um negócio essencial para o país — e uma cultura feita por gente que se importa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuação em embarcações, realizando toda a gestão de segurança dos navios;
  • Acompanhamento das agendas, documentações de segurança e gestão de EPI’s e uniformes;
  • Rotina de visitas aos navios e interface com a tripulação;
  • Promover inspeções nos navios identificando condições perigosas;
  • Controlar a implantação dos Programas de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR);
  • Preparar programas de treinamento sobre segurança do trabalho;
  • Analisar as ocorrências de Acidente de Trabalho;
  • Efetuar controle das informações referentes aos certificados para utilização dos EPIs;
  • Revisão e análise dos procedimentos internos relacionados à segurança do trabalho;
  • Prestar apoio à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Técnico de Segurança, com registro ativo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (rotina de viagens para visitas às embarcações);
  • Experiência no segmento de navegação / offshore será considerado um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde e odonto
  • Wellhub (atividade física e bem-estar)
  • Atendimento psicológico (Telavita)
  • Nutricionista
  • Shiatsu
  • Ticket alimentação/refeição
  • Cultura de desenvolvimento contínuo
  • Programas internos de reconhecimento e cuidado
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day off de aniversário

Fazer parte

É mais do que estar na maior empresa privada de cabotagem do Brasil — é fazer parte de um time que cuida do que faz e de quem faz acontecer.

Aqui, as relações importam. O respeito, a escuta e o apoio entre as pessoas são parte do trabalho, todos os dias.

Não buscamos perfeição nem fórmulas prontas. O que conta é o compromisso em construir junto, com responsabilidade, clareza e parceria.

A cultura da Norsul não está só nos valores escritos, mas nas atitudes de quem trabalha a bordo, no porto ou no escritório.

Ela se revela no jeito de colaborar, de ensinar, de aprender — e de manter a operação fluindo com confiança mútua.

Com mais de 60 anos de história, transportamos bauxita, minério de ferro, celulose e muito mais — conectando rotas no Brasil e no exterior, com segurança, consistência e compromisso com um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso trabalho movimenta o país, gera impacto positivo e transforma a vida de quem faz parte dele. Seja qual for o seu papel nessa jornada, o que você faz tem impacto.

Aqui, ninguém caminha sozinho. Cada pessoa importa. Cada trajetória tem valor.

Toda escala, travessia ou rotina é vivida com respeito e presença — e é isso que sustenta tudo o que a gente entrega.

Se esse jeito de trabalhar faz sentido pra você, o próximo embarque pode ser o seu!

description:
Overview

A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona. Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma como é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente. Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Advogado e a missão dessa posição é atuar na gestão jurídica da empresa, com foco em contratos, acompanhamento de escritórios parceiros e controle dos processos administrativos e judiciais. A posição exige visão de negócio, boa comunicação com áreas internas e capacidade de reduzir custos jurídicos externos por meio de análises e soluções internas.

Conhecimento prático de LGPD.

  • Interface com escritórios externos: Atuar como ponto focal entre a empresa e os escritórios jurídicos nas áreas societária, trabalhista, tributária e civil;
  • Controle administrativo: Organizar e controlar todos os assuntos jurídicos, garantindo rastreabilidade e histórico completo;
  • Gestão de marcas e ativos fixos: Acompanhar processos de renovação de marcas, patentes e registros relacionados aos ativos fixos da empresa;
  • Redução de custos jurídicos: Realizar análises e pareceres internos em casos e contratos de menor complexidade, evitando gastos desnecessários com escritórios externos;
  • Gestão financeira jurídica: Controlar despesas com escritórios terceirizados, validar faturas, aprovar pagamentos e manter relatórios de custos mensais por vertical;
  • Fechamento contábil e acompanhamento judicial: Consolidar mensalmente o status dos processos judiciais e administrativos, enviando relatórios de provisões e contabilizações à controladoria.

  • Vivência com contratos de obras e prestação de serviços;

  • Capacidade de comunicação e interface com múltiplas áreas internas;

Coordenar as atividades de Pré-Formulação, garantindo o desenvolvimento de formulações e processos seguros, robustos e com seus parâmetros críticos identificados. Overview

Procuramos um profissional com forte experiência em varejo, liderança orientada a resultados e visão analítica para impulsionar o crescimento da operação. O(a) Gerente Regional de Vendas será responsável por garantir o desempenho comercial, operacional e a excelência no atendimento das lojas sob sua gestão. Atuará diretamente no acompanhamento de indicadores, desenvolvimento dos times e execução de estratégias comerciais alinhadas à direção da empresa.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o desempenho comercial das lojas da região, acompanhando metas e resultados (vendas, ticket médio, conversão, perdas, despesas etc.).
  • Supervisionar grupos de lojas, garantindo padronização operacional e excelência no atendimento.
  • Conduzir o planejamento estratégico de vendas e assegurar que as ações sejam aplicadas nas lojas.
  • Desenvolver e orientar as lideranças das lojas, promovendo formação contínua de gerentes e equipes.
  • Garantir a execução dos padrões operacionais, políticas e rotinas da empresa.
  • Analisar oportunidades de mercado, concorrência e comportamento do consumidor para propor melhorias.
  • Acompanhar ações promocionais, campanhas e calendário comercial, assegurando a correta implementação.
  • Realizar visitas periódicas às unidades para avaliar desempenho, identificar gaps e conduzir planos de ação.
  • Assegurar excelência no atendimento ao cliente e na imagem das lojas.
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas corporativas (Comercial, RH, Operações, Marketing e Logística).
  • Capacidade de conduzir ações estratégicas para impulsionar resultados, assegurar o cumprimento das metas e construir um ambiente de trabalho orientado à performance.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo, preferencialmente em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Vivência sólida no varejo de moda e/ou lojas de departamento, preferencialmente em operações de grande fluxo.
  • Experiência comprovada em análise e gestão de performance financeira, incluindo indicadores de vendas, despesas, margem, perdas, ticket médio, conversão e rentabilidade das lojas.
  • Experiência como Gerente Regional, Gerente Distrital ou Supervisor Regional no varejo.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Pacote Office; Indicadores de performance comercial; Gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes; Visual merchandising (diferencial).

  • Salário compatível com o mercado

title: Roaming IREG Engineer - Lisbon-based
description:
Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Roaming IREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services. We are looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon-based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Maintain close relationships with external partners like carriers and service providers

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will impact the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: Collaborate with leaders and external advisors in a dynamic environment
  • Dynamic Work Environment: A collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged
  • Professional Development: Enhance your skills in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world
  • Open Communication Culture: An environment where ideas are heard and dialogue is encouraged
  • Get Things Done Attitude: A results-driven team that values impact

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data‑driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team‑first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail‑oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value‑selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Strategy & Planning

Location

Brazil

The Position

Reporting to the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGOs and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your Profile

Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations

  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.

Legacy Development

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organising, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post‑event reporting.

Communication & Stakeholder Relations

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.

Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience

  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: FARMACEUTICO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Sobre o Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Planejar, implementar e monitorar a distribuição de medicamentos, produtos e materiais nas diversas unidades do hospital, orientando sobre dados técnicos, tais como: dosagem, fórmula farmacêutica, composição química, substitutos etc; produzir; executar a guardar e controlar a distribuição de medicamentos; realizar controle diário dos estoques.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde.

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Escala: 12H trabalhadas x 60H de descanso
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura de TI II
description:
Overview

O que buscamos? Buscamos um profissional de Infraestrutura de TI, capaz de administrar e evoluir ambientes on-premises e em nuvem, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos serviços, com sólida base em Windows, Linux, redes, virtualização e segurança, bem como interesse em automação, padronização e boas práticas, boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa apoiando a modernização contínua da infraestrutura e o crescimento do negócio.

Atribuições Principais

  • Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
  • Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
  • Criar políticas de backup e segurança;
  • Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
  • Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
  • Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
  • Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
  • Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.

Requisitos

  • Administração de ambientes Windows Server, incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat), com experiência em gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
  • Domínio de protocolos de rede, incluindo TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
  • Conhecimento em hardware de rede, com configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
  • Experiência na configuração e suporte a serviços de rede, como VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, incluindo gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
  • Conhecimento em virtualização, utilizando ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
  • Experiência em storage, com gerenciamento de ambientes NAS e SAN, protocolos iSCSI e Fibre Channel, além da gestão de LUNs.
  • Configuração e administração de firewalls, como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
  • Implementação e gestão de rotinas de backup, políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes, utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento básico em Infrastructure as Code (IaC), com utilização de ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible.
  • Noções de containers, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script, como PowerShell ou Python, para automação de tarefas rotineiras.

Localidade da posição

Híbrido no Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Temos gana por performance
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
  • Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Onde estamos: temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Miami, Buenos Aires, Madrid e Perth. Além da localização física, promovemos uma cultura de integração de pessoas de qualquer lugar, com trabalho presencial ou remoto e um ambiente de colaboração, troca e desenvolvimento.

Como é o dia a dia da posição?

A MSF busca pessoas comprometidas com uma cultura de salvaguarda, promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e acolhedor para todas. Valorizamos profundamente a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações. Candidaturas alinhadas a esses valores serão altamente consideradas.

A história da BWT Operadora se cruza com a da Serra Verde Express, uma das mais importantes marcas do turismo do Brasil. Em 1997, o grupo de empresas familiares, liderado por Adonai Aires de Arruda, começou a operar o trem turístico da Serra do Mar Paranaense. Não demorou para visualizar uma oportunidade de diversificar seus negócios e ir além dos trilhos.

Com 14 anos de história, a BWT se destaca por sua atuação no turismo nacional e internacional, oferecendo uma ampla gama de produtos e serviços que atendem às necessidades e expectativas de seus clientes.

Hoje, a BWT está consolidada como uma das principais operadoras de turismo do país, reconhecida por sua excelência no atendimento, inovação constante e responsabilidade social.

Com matriz em Curitiba e escritórios em diversos estados, trabalhamos com dedicação e paixão para proporcionar experiências de viagem únicas e inesquecíveis.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada.

Buscamos um EXECUTIVO DE CONTAS, para:

  • Negociar contratos e condições comerciais, visando fechar acordos vantajosos para ambas as partes.
  • Analisar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e oportunidades para o crescimento do negócio.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação estratégicos para aumentar a receita e a rentabilidade da empresa na região.
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho da área comercial, propondo e implementando melhorias contínuas.
  • Participar de eventos e feiras do setor, representando a empresa e ampliando a rede de contatos.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas da empresa, como marketing e operações, para garantir a entrega de um serviço de qualidade aos clientes.

O que buscamos em você:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Turismo ou áreas correlatas.

title: Quality Data Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Introduction

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This position is for talented and experienced Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, volume, and accuracy of data across on‑prem and cloud environments. You will validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using IDMC, collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, results, and findings in a structured and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Apply IDMC coding skills, including creating end‑to‑end mappings with Filters, Routers, and Joiners.
  • Work with JSON structures, filters, and parsers to validate and transform data.
  • Apply basic Java knowledge to support custom code requirements.
  • Use Python to read and process data from various file formats, leveraging functions and libraries such as Pandas.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong background in software product development and delivery.
  • Solid expertise in SQL for data validation and transformation.
  • Proven ability to design and execute data test plans, scenarios, and cases, with clear documentation of results.
  • Strong knowledge of Informatica IDMC or related data management tools.
  • Experience with Azure Cloud technologies such as ADF and PySpark.
  • Proficiency in Python and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Ability to interpret and create System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams.
  • Background in Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

Minimum Position Qualifications / Education Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or related information technology field from an accredited institution or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of software product development and delivery experience.
  • 5+ years of SQL experience.
  • 3+ years of IDMC tool or related experience.
  • 3+ years’ experience overseeing the development of data test plans, test scenarios, test cases, execution of test case and documentation of test results.
  • 2+ years of experience in some of the Azure Cloud tools: ADF, Pyspark.
  • Experience with Python and libraries like Pandas.
  • Ability to interpret and draw System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Familiar with latest cloud technologies.

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical is a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business. This role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large, complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.

You will be managing projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

Responsibilities

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What we are looking for in you

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Requirements and skills

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação

Laudo médico válido e carimbado por médico especialista.

Bairro: Santa Cruz

Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência com CEDTEA, para atender crianças em Reabilitação Intelectual;
  • Pós Graduação e/ou Especialização na area de reabilitação.

Additional information

Local: Praça Seca

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Para compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital da Maternidade Paulino Werneck. Na função de Técnico de Enfermagem-CC, desempenhando as seguintes funções:

  • Incentiva a proteção e promoção do aleitamento materno, cuidado integral individual e humanizado ao cliente e família.
  • Prestar assistência de acordo com as metas internacionais de segurança do paciente, práticas de humanização, normas e rotinas institucionais.

Curso Técnico em Enfermagem com COREN ativo. Possuir experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses como Técnico de Enfermagem em rotinas hospitalares, preferencialmente linha materno infantil (Pronto socorro de ginecologia e obstetrícia, alojamento conjunto centro obstétrico e centro cirúrgico). title: Senior Director Cybersecurity
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will oversee and enhance the university's cybersecurity program within a sophisticated hybrid IT environment. This position combines visionary leadership typical of a cybersecurity executive with extensive technical expertise similar to that of a Security Architect and Engineer. The Senior Director will have primary accountability for securing the university's systems, applications, networks, and data, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and guiding technical teams in initiatives focused on threat prevention and mitigation.

Supervisory Authority

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will supervise a team of cybersecurity professionals, including managers, engineers, and analysts. This position holds the authority to make decisions regarding hiring, training, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions within the cybersecurity department.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students and staff of the department and University and Howard University Hospital CIO. External contacts include vendors, consultants, investigators, auditors, etc. Collaborate closely with the Chief Audit and Compliance Officer.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute a university-wide cybersecurity strategy that aligns with Howard University’s goals and emerging threat landscapes
  • Lead cross-functional cybersecurity governance initiatives, partnering with senior academic and administrative leaders to promote a security-first culture
  • Design, implement, and continuously evolve a secure infrastructure architecture across hybrid environments (on-premises and Azure cloud), including identity management (Entra ID), network segmentation, Zero Trust, and secure access
  • Evaluate and select enterprise-class security solutions: firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel), endpoint detection and response (EDR), encryption, and data loss prevention (DLP)
  • Conduct architectural risk analysis, threat modeling, and develop mitigation strategies for new and existing systems and applications
  • Ensure identity and access management (IAM) policies align with least privilege and role-based access control principles
  • Oversee real-time security monitoring, incident detection, and coordinated incident response efforts, utilizing SIEM and SOAR platforms
  • Drive security assessments, penetration tests, and red/blue team exercises to proactively identify and resolve vulnerabilities
  • Manage vulnerability management programs and ensure timely patch management across all systems
  • Maintain and test business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) plans related to information security incidents
  • Coordinate with other departments to integrate cybersecurity measures into business processes
  • Monitor and analyze security metrics to provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Stay informed about the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies

Core Competencies

Expert experience in the following:

  • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
  • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, RAIDUS PS, CAs
  • Bare metal servers and data center configurations
  • Falcon Crowdstrike
  • Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
  • Hybrid cloud integrations
  • Authentication protocols
  • Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
  • Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper-V).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE
  • Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations
  • Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security
  • Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams in promoting a culture of compliance and cybersecurity accountability across the enterprise.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity policies, controls, and compliance frameworks within complex IT environments.
  • Strong experience with cybersecurity risk management processes, including risk assessments, business impact analyses (BIAs), and control mapping.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in computer science/ Information Technology with a security concentration and a Master’s degree in business administration is highly desirable. Industry certifications in cybersecurity are preferred and 10 to 15 years of experience in information security. Minimum three years’ experience working with firewall, vulnerability scanning, intrusion detection products and authentication technologies and three years of experience with network security, incident response, auditing, intrusion detection, forensics, vulnerability assessments, and/or analytic tools; or equivalent combination of education and experience. One or more of the following: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CGEIT, CRISC, and, or other security certification.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$160,000-$170,000

Acompanhar retorno de rotas ao centro de vendas

Monitorar e tratar semanalmente jornada laboral dos colaboradores com foco em evitar ocorrências.

Controle de colaboradores através de pastas e folha de serviço, manter em dia a documentação.

Validar mensalmente apuração dos KPIS para pagamento de remuneração variável.

Enviar semanalmente semana típica a Coordenação.

Garantir preenchimento do quadro básico autorizado (tramo x nômina).

Realizar investigação dos acidentes/incidentes com plano de mitigação de riscos e evitar novas ocorrências.

Realizar mensalmente a Matriz de Auto Controle (MAC), reportar a Gestão Imediata e evidenciar na pasta de Controle Nacional.

Prestar constas semanal e mensalmente a Coordenação e Gerência da área sobre os KPIS da área.

title: Manager, Volunteer Operations
description:
Manager, Volunteer Operations

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities. In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability. Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities. We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time‑management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on‑site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Ao longo de até 24 meses , o programa oferece uma jornada intensa de desenvolvimento, com projetos reais, exposição direta a lideranças e acompanhamento estruturado, preparando talentos para assumir posições estratégicas dentro da companhia.

Mais do que um programa de entrada, o Global Trainee é uma das principais portas de crescimento dentro do Grupo Techint , do qual a Ternium faz parte. Hoje, cerca de 70% da alta liderança do grupo foi formada por esse programa - incluindo o nosso atual presidente, Máximo Vedoya .

Essa vaga funciona como um banco de talentos ativo . Durante o processo seletivo, os candidatos passam por etapas de avaliação e testes de mapeamento de habilidades, competências e perfil , permitindo uma análise aprofundada do potencial de cada participante.

Os profissionais aprovados permanecem elegíveis no banco e passam a ser chamados conforme surgem oportunidades alinhadas ao seu perfil e às necessidades da companhia, em diferentes áreas e momentos ao longo do ano.

Áreas de atuação

As oportunidades podem surgir em áreas industriais e administrativas , com atuação transversal ao negócio e forte interface com diferentes times e unidades da Ternium.

  • Formação em Engenharias, Administração , Economia , Contabilidade , Relações Internacionais , Ciências Atuariais , Comunicação , Direito , Marketing , Publicidade e Propaganda , Psicologia , Sistemas da Informação , entre outros cursos superiores;
  • Estar no último período da graduação ou ter até 2 anos de formado(a) ;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no formato 4 dias presenciais + 1 dia home office ;
  • Segunda a quinta: 07h40 às 17h00
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no Rio de Janeiro (RJ) .
  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Bradesco;
  • Vale-alimentação iFood;
  • Alimentação no local;
  • Ônibus fretado e complementação de passagem (quando necessário);
  • Férias remuneradas;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Programa de assistência jurídica, financeira e psicológica;
  • Seguro de vida.

Diferenciais do Programa

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento estruturada para formação de lideranças;
  • Treinamentos pela Ternium University , nossa universidade corporativa;
  • Avaliação de performance e feedback semestrais;
  • Projetos reais, com alta visibilidade para lideranças;
  • Cultura de segurança como valor inegociável;
  • Contato com clientes, áreas e times da Ternium em outros países.

Etapas do processo seletivo

  • Inscrição;
  • Entrevista com o RH;
  • Entrevista case com a liderança;
  • Entrevistas com a diretoria.

Maior siderúrgica da América Latina, a Ternium é referência em produção de aços especiais. Nossa atuação é focada no cliente, na segurança, no uso de alta tecnologia e na sustentabilidade ambiental.

Desde 2017, operamos em uma usina moderna localizada em Santa Cruz (RJ) , com capacidade para produzir até 5 milhões de toneladas de placas de aço por ano .

Atendemos às indústrias automotiva, de óleo e gás, de maquinário, linha branca, naval e de energia, em diversos continentes.

Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento local é concreto. Já investimos mais de R$ 11 bilhões no Brasil e somos a maior acionista da Usiminas , principal produtora de aços planos do país, consolidando nossa presença e relevância no setor.

Com infraestrutura integrada, incluindo porto próprio para exportação e logística ferroviária , garantimos eficiência, agilidade e qualidade ao longo de toda a cadeia produtiva.

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott.
